# @handamade/psi-mcp — MCP access to Psi (Ψ)

Four tools over a baked index of the generated artifacts. Each returns text; none writes files or calls a model (D43, D129):
- search(query): briefs {id, kind, title, summary}; empty query = overview, where pattern rows are {id, kind, summary} (the id names the pattern, D100), guides and token pages get one row each (guide:*, tokens:*), and one row names every component with the total (component:*) and one counts the icons (icons:all) (D145)
- get(id): markdown. component → its whole docs page, identical to psi.kurkin.de/docs/components/<page>.md (examples, props, keyboard, theming, rules) | tokens:<page> → a token page | guide:<id> → a guide | token → formula + OKLCH/hex per theme | topic → guidance | pattern → compose tree, parameters, content, gaps/blocked, preset (JSX, or a component when the pattern holds state, D143) | icon:<Name> → its import line, keywords and props | icons:all → every icon with its keywords and the shared props | hook:<name> → the component page that tables the hook's API (useToast on Toast's, useFieldControl on Field's) (D145)
- theme({color | hue, chroma?, radius?, name?}): CSS for an AA-solved light and dark theme ([data-psi-theme="<name>"] and "<name>-dark"), install lines, contrast table
- check({code}): findings on a JSX snippet: unknown-export, unknown-prop, invalid-value, missing-required, slot, accessible-name; icons are checked against their shared props and SVG attributes; an unknown prop's hint is the component's own prop first (a typo, or the same words: onValueChange → onChange), then a DOM attribute (D145); spreads and computed values are skipped, never guessed
Ids: component:<Name>, tokens:<page>, guide:<id>, token:<name>, topic:<key>, pattern:<id>, icon:<Name>, icons:all, hook:<name>; bare names resolve case-insensitively (`icons` is icons:all).

Connect: https://psi.kurkin.de/mcp (Streamable HTTP) or `npx @handamade/psi-mcp` (stdio).
Agent context: `npx @handamade/psi-mcp init [--claude]` writes a marker-delimited block into AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md (D44).
The index bakes packages/react/dist/{manifest.json,patterns.json} (patterns.json: 24 composition patterns with clarifying parameters, blocked/gaps flags, preset JSX or components) + packages/tokens/dist/{guidance.json,resolved/*.json} + every docs page's markdown, rendered by the same builders as the docs site (D129) at publish; lockstep versioning keeps it truthful (D43).
